def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    bg=8
    cells=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in g]
    t=min(i for i,_ in cells); b=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    l=min(j for _,j in cells); r=max(j for _,j in cells)
    rc=Counter(i for i,_ in cells); cc=Counter(j for _,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(t,b+1):
        for j in range(l,r+1):
            if out[i][j]==bg and (rc[i]>=3 or cc[j]>=3): out[i][j]=2
    return out
print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
o=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in o: print(r)
print(json.dumps(o))

lib = '''def fill_box_gaps(g, bg=8, fill=2):
    """Complete dotted box strokes: fill gaps on side lines always; on interior lines only when the line has a run of >=2 dots."""
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    dots = [(i, j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (bg, fill)]
    if not dots:
        return [row[:] for row in g]
    rs = [p[0] for p in dots]; cs = [p[1] for p in dots]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        idx = [j for j in range(c0, c1 + 1) if g[r][j] not in (bg, fill)]
        if len(idx) < 2 or (r, c0) not in dots or (r, c1) not in dots:
            continue
        side = (r, c0) in dots and (r, c1) in dots and (idx == [c0, c1] or g[r][c0] != bg and g[r][c1] != bg)
        has_run = any(idx[k+1] - idx[k] == 1 for k in range(len(idx) - 1))
        if side or has_run:
            for j in range(min(idx), max(idx) + 1):
                if out[r][j] == bg:
                    out[r][j] = fill
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        idx = [i for i in range(r0, r1 + 1) if g[i][c] not in (bg, fill)]
        if len(idx) < 2:
            continue
        side = (r0, c) in dots and (r1, c) in dots
        has_run = any(idx[k+1] - idx[k] == 1 for k in range(len(idx) - 1))
        if side or has_run:
            for i in range(min(idx), max(idx) + 1):
                if out[i][c] == bg:
                    out[i][c] = fill
    return out
'''
